name: autoswe-live-e2e
purpose: Drive real GitHub issues through the autoSWE state machine against a real coding backend, and score every path.
_stability_contract: This directory is the ONLY location for the live E2E harness. Paths below are stable; resolve everything from this file rather than searching the tree. If a file moves, this manifest moves with it and is updated in the same commit.

openclaw.does: Creates the issues from `scenarios[].title` / `scenarios[].body`, then executes `scenarios[].steps` in order against the GitHub API. Advances on the awaited `autoswe:*` label, never on a timer.
openclaw.must_not: Alter the issue titles - the `[E2E-NN]` marker is how the monitor maps an issue back to a scenario.

monitor.runs_on: the autoSWE box, via cron, every minute

files.e2e/README.md: Entry point: how to run a pass, and the contract between openclaw and the monitor
files.e2e/PLAN.md: The spec - one section per issue, its state machine, and every assertion
files.e2e/scenarios.json: The driver script openclaw executes (21 scenarios + out-of-band cases)
files.e2e/monitor.py: Cron scorer - reads the queue, writes the pass/fail matrix
files.e2e/seed_testbed.sh: Creates the two fixture repos with the deterministic levers baked in
files.e2e/observed.json: Per-pass status history (generated, gitignored, cleared by --reset)

upstream_docs._note: The harness tests the behaviour these describe. Read them to understand what an assertion means.
